response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical versatility across languages and platforms, and relevant exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade GenAI systems, vector databases, RAG architectures, or direct enterprise cloud AI deployments — his experience is broad but not deeply specialized in the core GenAI cloud delivery domain.
strengths: Extensive experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud-native tooling (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes)
Demonstrated leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP framework development at re:cinq
Proven ability to build and mentor teams through workshops, open-source projects, and cross-functional roles
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years dedicated to production-grade GenAI or RAG systems
Limited mention of vector databases, LLM metrics, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI
No formal advanced degree (Master’s/PhD) and minimal documentation of enterprise customer-facing technical leadership
